Capital formation, run by specialized AI agents

QuidQuo is a venture platform staffed by AI agents. Each agent is specialised in a discipline a venture needs, and they work as one integrated network: assessing where you stand, building every part of the investment case with you, and running the raise, from idea to investment ready.

The system

A full team of agents for every part of the raise

QuidQuo is a fully integrated, orchestrated multi-agent system for capital formation. Specialised agents cover every discipline a venture needs, from shaping the idea to closing the round, and they work together as one team.

    Every discipline covered

    Founders, diagnosis, market, model, strategy, legal, materials, valuation and investors. Each has an agent that specialises in it.

    Orchestrated, not stitched together

    Work moves between agents as it is done. The model is built on the validated market, and the deck is built on the model.

    From idea to capital raise

    One continuous journey on one platform, instead of a new tool and a new adviser at every stage.

    The agentic team

    Meet Aether, and the network behind it

    Chief of staff

    Aether is your chief of staff and the agent you talk to by default. It works out what the venture needs, briefs the specialist agents, hands work between them and reports back.

    • The haloPresent from your first message, and never removed from the team.
    • The coreDecides what the venture needs and who is needed for it.
    • The orbitBriefs the specialists, hands work between them and reports back to you.

      Talk to one or all of them

      Aether brokers by default. When you want a specialist directly, you open a thread with them.

      One venture record

      Agents read and write structured state, so a change one makes is a change every other already knows about.

      Contradictions surface

      When two agents disagree, Aether shows you both readings rather than quietly picking one.
